title: Yesterday
blurb: Talk about what you did and when you did it.

exercises.prompt: How do you say "the day before yesterday"?

tip.title: Time words
tip.body: Put the time word first or last. Hier soir, j'ai mangé. J'ai mangé hier soir. Il y a deux jours means 2 days ago.

exercises.prompt: How do you say "2 days ago"?
Last week I saw my sister

tip.title: Past with avoir
tip.body: Most past verbs use j'ai plus a past form. J'ai mangé means I ate. Tu as vu means you saw.

exercises.prompt: I went to the market yesterday

tip.title: Past with être
tip.body: Verbs of movement use je suis, not j'ai. Je suis allé au parc. A woman adds an e in writing: je suis allée.

exercises.prompt: How do you say "I went home"?
How do you say "it was raining"?
On Saturday the weather was nice

tip.title: How it was
tip.body: Use c'était and il faisait to say how things were. Learn them as set phrases for now. C'était super. Il faisait beau.

exercises.prompt: How do you say "we watched a film"?
On Sunday I visited a park
What does "qu'est-ce que tu as fait" mean?
How do you say "what did you do (polite)"?

tip.title: Asking about the past
tip.body: Use tu with friends and vous with people you don't know. Qu'est-ce que tu as fait ? Qu'est-ce que vous avez fait ?
